say:2:1041534101:1.text: It's actually starting to snow outside. This really sets the mood.
say:2:1041534101:1.source_cn: 外面居然下起雪来了，倒是很有氛围嘛。

say:3:1041534102:1.text: The decorations are almost done, the lights and satin ribbons... everything's coming together.
say:3:1041534102:1.source_cn: 这里也装饰得差不多了，灯光，彩缎……

say:4:1041534103:1.text: I heard one of the familiars say the snowflake patterns were specially commissioned by the Mithril Consortium.
say:4:1041534103:1.source_cn: 听使魔说，这些雪花纹样是请秘银商会专门定制的。

say:5:1041534104:1.text: Oh? This thing on the table... I thought it was just a flower, but it's actually a lamp.
say:5:1041534104:1.source_cn: 噢？这桌子上的……我以为是花，结果是灯啊。

say:6:1041534105:1.text: Quite intriguing, isn't it? If you infuse it with magic, the light transforms.
say:6:1041534105:1.source_cn: 很精致吧？如果注入魔力，光芒会变得更有趣。

say:7:1041534106:1.text: Indeed, it looks like starlight... This really feels like a festive atmosphere.
say:7:1041534106:1.source_cn: 确实，像是星光一样……这下可真是太有过节的感觉了。

say:8:1041534107:1.text: I wish my teacher were here.
say:8:1041534107:1.male: I wish my teacher were here.
say:8:1041534107:1.female: I wish my teacher were here.

say:9:1041534108:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... Yes, I wonder when he'll return. I hope he's able to see all of this.
say:9:1041534108:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... Yes, I wonder when he'll return. I hope he's able to see all of this.
say:9:1041534108:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... Yes, I wonder when she'll return. I hope she's able to see all of this.
